execution_policy: Synthetic signed principal/mandate records and test keys only; no real Owner credentials or live authority grants.

cases.scenario: Trusted issuer signs an active principal registration and exact-scope mandate; source class and temporal interval are allowed; evidence commitments match.
cases.expected: Valid decision with exact mandate scope and all evidence flags true.

cases.scenario: Principal registration or mandate signature is invalid, unknown, revoked, or revocation state is unavailable.
cases.expected: Fail closed; no scope is returned.

cases.scenario: Claimed authority ID, source class, mandate reference, principal binding or mandate scope is substituted.
cases.expected: Fail closed; signed records must bind the exact authority, class, mandate and scope.

cases.scenario: Timestamp is noncanonical, invalid, interval is inverted, record is expired/not-yet-valid, or null expiry is not explicitly permitted.
cases.expected: Fail closed or expired; no scope is returned.

cases.scenario: Delegation chain is missing, cyclic/duplicated, or provenance/version evidence commitment differs.
cases.expected: Fail closed; no authority expansion or execution permission.
